User: Terry drives at a speed of 40 miles per hour. He drives daily forth and back from his home to his workplace which is 60 miles away from his home. How many hours does Terry spend driving from home to the workplace and then back?
Assistant: <think>

Terry drives 60 miles to the workplace and 60 miles back, so the total distance driven is 60 + 60 = 120 miles. If he drives at a speed of 40 miles per hour, the time taken to drive to the workplace is 120 / 40 = 3 hours. Since he drives back home, the total time spent driving is 3 hours + 3 hours = 6 hours.</think> <answer>6</answer>
